name: elysia-structured-logger
description: Structured wide-event logging plugin for Elysia applications.

scripts.build: bun run clean && bun build ./src/index.ts --outdir ./dist --format esm --target node --external elysia && bunx tsc --project tsconfig.json --emitDeclarationOnly
scripts.typecheck: bunx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && bunx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.test.json
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build
scripts.release:patch: bun run release:prepare && bun run release:version:patch && bun run release:publish
scripts.release:minor: bun run release:prepare && bun run release:version:minor && bun run release:publish
scripts.release:major: bun run release:prepare && bun run release:version:major && bun run release:publish
